# Browser-test audio fixture

`clip.wav` is an original synthesized performance of the public-domain melody “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star”, generated for the initial test setup. No third-party recording was sampled. To the extent copyright subsists in this supplied recording, it is dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ .

This file is only a deterministic test fixture. It is not a real-song preview, not served by the production build, and not available as a game collection. Browser tests mock provider responses and route audio to this file so decoding and timing can be tested without claiming a live catalog integration has passed.
